title: Stable Matching with Peer-Dependent Preferences: Existence and Cutoff Characterization
abstract: arXiv:2608.18381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a framework for stable matching markets that accommodates the peer-dependent preferences employed in empirical work. We show the existence of a stable matching in a continuum economy and of an approximately stable matching in a large finite sampled economy under assumptions satisfied by standard empirical specifications. The analysis builds on a tractable characterization of stable matchings with peer-dependent preferences in terms of supply and demand equations along with a rational-expectations condition.

translated_title: 具有同伴依赖偏好的稳定匹配：存在性与截止特征描述
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个稳定匹配市场的框架，该框架能够容纳实证研究中采用的同伴依赖偏好。我们证明，在连续经济体中存在稳定匹配，并且在大型有限样本经济体中，在标准实证规范所满足的假设下，存在近似稳定匹配。分析基于同伴依赖偏好下稳定匹配的可处理特征描述，该描述通过供需方程以及理性预期条件来表述。
tldr: 本文提出了一种框架，证明在同伴依赖偏好下稳定匹配的存在性，并通过供需方程和理性预期条件提供了可处理的特征描述。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework proving the existence of stable matching under peer-dependent preferences and provides a tractable characterization via supply-demand equations and rational-expectations conditions.
